item.title: Version 1.5.2
item.description:
Added

  • 3 more vHealth rules (RVTools #17/#20/#21, 15 of 24 documented rules now implemented): ESXi Shell enabled and SSH enabled — a plain warning when either management service is running on a host (TSM/ TSM-SSH, confirmed against govmomi's own simulator fixtures). NTP issue — flags a host with no NTP servers configured at all, or one where servers are configured but the ntpd service isn't actually running (a real, common misconfiguration that config alone doesn't catch — a server list existing doesn't mean time is actually being synced). All three read directly off the same host property fetch collectAll already does (config.service, config.dateTimeInfo) — no extra vCenter round-trip.
